claim: Three role-open analytics reads still serve a sales figure that predates ADR 0298 to any member of the house: pos-revenue, basket and insights in apps/api-gateway/src/analytics/analytics.controller.ts. The claim holds once each carries @Roles( with RolesGuard (on the route or the class) among its own decorators, or policyFor(/withSales/salesGateFor( in its body (ADR 0145 ROLE_POLICY, ADR 0290 §5). The verify also checks table-performance, waiters and hot-tables, which ADR 0348 gave RolesGuard + @Roles("owner", "manager") (claim A-TABLE-AND-SERVER-TAKINGS-NEED-A-MANAGER), so removing either guard there reopens it. Not checked, because a grep cannot tell them from the gated code beside them: the stored insights overview composes, the generated insights in consult's evidence pack, and the check-based goal metrics (wine_revenue, avg_check, checks). Carried from PR #617's row when #617 was split (ADR 0298, 2026-10-31), verify unchanged; #617's prose still said six routes. Measured 2026-10-31 on this branch: prints OPEN: pos-revenue, basket, insights; with salesGateFor( added to all three bodies it HOLDS, with two it prints OPEN: insights.
